findings.where: Section headings: 'Vibe' compared with its siblings 'Surf' and 'Good for' (desktop and phone)
findings.fault: One section heading is set unlike the others. 'Vibe' is italic, larger, turquoise and underlined, while 'Surf' and 'Good for' are plain ink Quicksand at one size. The underline and colour together make it look like a link, but the parts map shows it is static. It also sets type in a raw turquoise fill colour.
findings.who_objects: The backpacker scanning the guide. They read the odd heading either as a link that does nothing when tapped or as a mistake, and the page's structure of parallel sections stops being clear. A brand reviewer would also object to a fill colour used as text.

findings.where: All running text: the intro paragraph, the Surf and Vibe paragraphs, the 'What to look for' paragraph and the coming-soon notice. Worst at 390 px, e.g. the notice's first line 'MantaHostels   is   launching   across'
findings.fault: Body copy is fully justified with no hyphenation. In narrow columns this opens wide, uneven gaps between words and visible rivers, and on the phone some lines are mostly white space.
findings.who_objects: The backpacker reading on a phone, often mid-transit. Uneven word spacing breaks reading rhythm and makes short paragraphs feel laboured, which goes against the brand's 'effortless' first feeling.

findings.where: 'What to look for' heading (desktop-02 top; phone, after the chips)
findings.fault: This section heading is set as a small, tracked, all-caps label, while every other section heading on the page ('Surf', 'Vibe', 'Good for') is a mixed-case Quicksand heading. The rules file keeps uppercase for badges and filter labels.
findings.who_objects: A reader using the headings to find their way. The section that answers the page's second job, what to look for in a hostel, looks like a caption, not a peer section, so it is easy to skim past. The brand owner would also object to uppercase outside its sanctioned uses.

findings.where: Page title 'Best Hostels in Canggu' (desktop and phone)
findings.fault: The title is in Title Case, but the brand voice is sentence case ('Best hostels in Canggu'), and every other heading on the page follows that.
findings.who_objects: The brand owner, because the house voice is sentence case throughout. The most prominent line on the page is the one that departs from it.
